field.acOnly: Only stay awake while plugged in
mode.auto.desc: Stays awake while an AI agent is working, then lets your Mac sleep.
mode.on.desc: Always keeps your Mac awake. Safety limits still apply.
mode.off.desc: Lets your Mac sleep normally, even while an agent is working.
mode.remote.desc: Keeps your Mac awake and reachable from your phone or another device.
hint.timing: How long to wait after the work stops, and how often Lumen checks.
hint.sessions: Lumen keeps your Mac awake while Claude Code or Codex is active.
hint.processList: Separate names with commas — for example: ollama, docker, node.
hint.safety: These limits can only allow sleep. They never keep your Mac awake on their own.
about.tagline: Keeps your Mac awake only while an AI agent is actually working.
about.daemonInstalled: Background helper is installed and running.
about.daemonMissing: Background helper isn't set up yet.
about.privilege: Lumen sets up a small background helper once, asking for your macOS password a single time. Everyday controls never need a password.
status.awake: Awake — you can close the lid
reason.notInstalled: Open the About tab to finish setup.
reason.idle: No agent running — your Mac can sleep
reason.manualOff: You chose to let it sleep
reason.manualOn: You chose to keep it awake
reason.hardCapWaiting: Time limit reached — waiting for a quiet moment
reason.hardCap: Awake for %dh — letting your Mac rest for now
reason.criticalBattery: Battery low (%d%%) — sleeping to protect it
reason.batteryFloor: Battery at %d%% — letting your Mac sleep
reason.acOnly: On battery — will stay awake once you plug in
reason.thermal: Running hot — letting your Mac cool down
install.firstRunPrompt: Lumen needs to set up a small background helper to manage sleep. macOS will ask for your password once.
install.reinstallPrompt: Reinstall or update Lumen's background helper? macOS will ask for your password once.
alert.installed: Lumen's background helper is installed and running.
